## Coverage report

Totals: 84 REQs — 78 verified, 5 implemented, 1 approved, 0 draft. M9 in progress (2026-08-06): TOOL-017/018/019/020 + API-007 verified at STEP-M9-020/030/040 (TOOL-018's attended criterion carried open, gate-scheduled); REQ-API-008 (ABI freeze) is the last approved REQ, step M9-050 in `todo/`. The 5 implemented (BUILD-002/004, TOOL-001/002/014) stay as before — live/manual-only, by convention.

- **Approved REQs with no code tag (unimplemented):** REQ-API-008 — the ABI-freeze/1.0.0 release act, step M9-050 next. Expected at this point in the rolling wave.
- **Code without a tagged passing test (unverified):** REQ-BUILD-002, REQ-BUILD-004, REQ-TOOL-001, REQ-TOOL-002, REQ-TOOL-014. Tool/build REQs exercised manually or by running CI rather than by a `verifies:` unit test — TOOL-001/002 (status/checkin, driven live), TOOL-014 (reboot, disruptive/live — like TOOL-001/002), BUILD-002 (CI, self-verifying on each run), BUILD-004 (`./dev`). Behavior covered by the live gates.
- **Orphan tags (naming a nonexistent REQ):** none.
- **Broken architecture anchors:** none.
- **`done/` steps with empty `evidence.commits` (hygiene):** the M1 steps (STEP-M1-030..110, squashed `M1 complete` history) and STEP-M2-040/045/050 (commits f3f125f / 374ab55 / f99bb72, known from the M2 gate but not yet backfilled into the step files). All M3–M6 steps carry their SHAs. Non-blocking — code/test evidence is present and green.
- **Deliberately open acceptance criteria:** two carried, by design — REQ-SYS-008 attended-manual shutdown (recovery is a physical power-cycle; may stay open indefinitely) and REQ-KEY-008 dedup-across-delete-after-reboot re-probe (a firmware-behavior observation to confirm at leisure; the tests use per-run-unique material so it cannot cause false failures) — both scheduled for disposition at the M9-060 gate (resolve or re-carry, user decision). One M9 item stays open by design until its scheduled moment: the REQ-TOOL-018 attended `--mobile` live leg (approve + reject on the real phone, M9-060 gate — REQ otherwise verified from unit + scripted-broker + offline/live-smoke evidence). Every other M7 decomposition probe was RESOLVED live with recorded values and regression-pinned tests; the six firmware/doc divergences are documented in KNOWN-ISSUES.
- **Test-infra REQs realized without a `src/` code tag:** REQ-TEST-001/002/003/004 verified via their test files / support (the test *is* the implementation); REQ-TEST-005 realized in `dev` + a `supports:` tag in `tests/support/integration_env.h` (the harness change every gated live run exercises). The established TEST-area convention — not a coverage gap.
- **REQs in needs-reverify:** none.
